Portable automatic card tester type (ATUPI ), made by Zat 
 company.
The portable automatic DIAMO unit tester ATU P1 used for testing and verifying the logic units DIAMO.

It comprises an assembly of input and output display unit converters and a 
 Control board fitted with p Z 80 the memory part of the control board is 
 Located on the front panel of the instrument and it is designed as a plug in 
 Interchangeable module.
The testing program for the respective unit type is stored inside this module.

The tested unit is plugged into four URS connectors fixed on the front panel 
 of the tester.

The control is placed on the front 
 panel and it consists of a press-button set and Of a seven-segment display.

Put the reference programming cards (k110 OR k810 OR k530 OR k540) in 
 position (A) tester.
Put the tested card in position (B) tester which we need to test.
قم بتوصيل مصدر الطاقة بجهاز الاختبار وحدد الوضع التلقائي.
The display list indicate the type of program tested card.
Press (start) button to start the test

The tester now is ready to run program of testing all function of the card and 
 holding at any one of trouble occur and appear in digital monitor.
Press (START) tester with press (ON) push bottom of tested card.
Press push bottom (OFF) in tested card with press (START) of tester.

Press both switch (ON) + (OFF) on tested card at the same time with press 
 (START) in tester, wait up to the mark (END) appear in display
